rationale: Revised plan corrects two critical issues identified in the evaluation: (1) denial_rate now uses adjudicated_claims denominator to exclude Pended claims and report the correct denial rate (1286/12339 = 10.42% instead of 1286/12845 = 10.01%), and (2) monthly_trend now keys on service_date_from instead of adjudication_date to analyze claim volume when service occurred rather than when claims were processed, avoiding lag-induced inconsistencies. All other components and parameters remain unchanged. Plan continues to address each objective in the task spec and produce all required artifacts.
changes_summary: Two parameter corrections: (1) denial_rate.denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude Pended claims and compute the correct denial rate; (2) monthly_trend.date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to key the trend on when service began rather than when the claim was processed.
